chunks: So We saved him and his whole family
ai.seo_question: Who did God save along with the Prophet according to this verse?
ai.summary: While the verse in Surah Ash-Shu'ara (26:69) grammatically refers to Prophet Hud (AS) and his family, Shia exegetes often draw a thematic parallel to the Ahl al-Bayt, viewing the 'collective salvation' as a precursor to the spiritual purity of the Prophet's household. This deliverance underscores the divine protection granted to the righteous lineage, reinforcing the concept of 'Tathir' (purification) and the distinct status of the Prophet's family in Shia theology.
